scope: Continuation of the memory-layout campaign, compared with the preserved local source already containing prior optimizations. Descriptive local timings, not a general speed guarantee.

invariant_audit.analytic_reduction_note: Original parallel np.dot reductions reproduced as ordered scalar loops in the serial/shared helper; verified against independent frozen parallel kernel, not inferred from AST alone.

full_solver_comparison.scope: Warm native solve timings; baseline process precedes candidate. Same inputs, no continuation seeds. Exact arrays checked; differences reported without relaxing solver acceptance.

jacobian_microbenchmark_and_rejected_sol.scope: Warmed current-code A/B variants, seven alternating samples, same process, 4 Numba threads and BLAS=1. Full saved states; comparisons outside timing. No complete-solver speedup implied.
jacobian_microbenchmark_and_rejected_sol.solve_trial_status: Rejected automatic solve workspace integration; micro solve rows describe that trial, not the selected BorderedFactor. Jacobian rows are independent of this integration and use the final exact chemistry accumulation.

derivative_storage_estimate.note: Static storage of Jy and Jt only; excludes concentrations, block matrices, factor inverses, transport scratch and allocator/RSS. Automatic solve workspace retention was rejected and is absent from the selected default.

baseline_diagnostic_profile.scope: Single diagnostic sample per case; all inclusive timers reset after compile_kernels, captured at solve_diffusion_problem return. Nested categories overlap. Warmup not measured. No performance change measured.

baseline_thread_sweep.scope: One sequential process per group; three samples per case, warmed exact configuration, BLAS=1. Repeated 4-thread control estimates process/time drift; descriptive, no universal optimum.

rejected_numerical_trial.reason: Serial np.dot in the shared helper changed last bits relative to original parallel reductions. Rejected before final selection; repaired using original-order scalar accumulations.

reproduction.note: The preserved baseline and exploratory scripts are local ignored files. Published JSON includes raw samples and exact-comparison results.
